copyrightBoundary: Historical Apple artwork is evidence-only. Product assets are original measured reconstructions and semantic adaptations; no screenshot crops, extracted resources, traced paths, or embedded Apple bitmaps are shipped.

platinum.light: upper-left, discrete one-pixel highlight; lower-right structural shade
platinum.perspective: compact front or shallow three-quarter object view; removable media front-on
platinum.edge: integer pixel grid, dark selective keyline, hard alpha, no soft filter shadow
platinum.acceptance: Inspect 32 and 16 independently at 100, 200, and 400 percent with nearest-neighbor scaling. Direct-prototype silhouettes must be compared before palette tuning.

aqua.light: above and slightly toward the viewer; bright early-Aqua highlight with object-owned cast shadow
aqua.perspective: user applications sit on a desk and widen toward the base; utilities are straight-on; documents hover; media is front-on
aqua.edge: anti-aliased alpha, illustrated material edge, no CSS gloss or global drop shadow
aqua.acceptance: The 128 master establishes material and perspective; 32 and 16 are separately composed hints with deleted detail and stronger recognition edges.

snow-leopard.light: controlled overhead key light with restrained ambient fill and object-specific contact shadow
snow-leopard.perspective: mature OS X genre split: desk perspective for user apps, shelf perspective for utilities, hovering paper for documents, front-on removable media
snow-leopard.edge: high-resolution material detail, subtle alpha, no shared Aqua anatomy and no theme-wide CSS shadow
snow-leopard.colorSpace: References are normalized to sRGB for browser review; source profile provenance remains in the ignored evidence cache.
snow-leopard.acceptance: 512 and 128 own richer texture; 32 and 16 are separately simplified and may move details. New application objects must disappear convincingly into a mixed 10.6 family.

yosemite.light: soft frontal-upper light with shallow shading; no skeuomorphic cast-shadow theatre
yosemite.perspective: flattened but object-specific Finder and application silhouettes; Retina hairlines and compact optical centers
yosemite.edge: clean anti-aliased fill shapes, light steel-blue keyline, limited gradients, no squircle container and no uniform outline-glyph pack
yosemite.acceptance: Retina large art remains flatter and clearer than 10.6 while preserving distinct object silhouettes. The 16 pixel family uses fewer strokes and stronger filled marks.

liquid-glass.target: Apple Liquid Glass icon language (2025–2026), adapted to AI System 6 semantic objects
liquid-glass.light: vertical light from above, with crisp specular rims and object-owned contact shadows
liquid-glass.perspective: simple layered physical metaphors; app objects may use a bounded canvas, while disks, folders, documents, tools, and media retain independent silhouettes
liquid-glass.edge: translucent layered fills with controlled refraction cues and bright specular edges; no theme-wide CSS glass tile, outline pack, or indiscriminate squircle container
liquid-glass.acceptance: Every one of the 54 semantic objects has an independent runtime file, object-specific silhouette, layered material, and 16 pixel hint. Inspect all four sizes on both light and dark photographic backgrounds; small art must remain identifiable without depending on the label.
